judge.rationale: The finding explicitly names the bypass (API handler writes directly through InventoryRepository, bypassing the single write path of InventoryReservationService), cites ADR-004 specifically with its file path and quoted rule text rather than a generic layering preference, proposes a remedy that routes the write through InventoryReservationService (instantiating the service and calling service.save), and pins the finding to api_handler.py:7. All four criteria are satisfied.
